_comment: Ingested (pre-filter) corpus for 17 Jul 2026. Five roster dailies that survive the filter, plus decoys that each demonstrate one exclusion reason. The four no-report designers (Mariam, Tamari, Maarja, Vlad) deliberately produce no records. Bodies are faithful to design-daily-2026-07-17-v8.html so a live LLM run can reproduce the golden digest.
